signals.text: How 'anti-superstar' Kane defied doubters to become world's best. Harry Kane is the humble 'anti-superstar' who defied doubters to achieve Ballon d'Or greatness, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.
Wenger's 'daylight' offside trial unlikely to be extended. Arsene Wenger's "daylight" offside trial is unlikely to be extended after receiving a lack of support at the Ifab assessment panels.
